calling_convention.inputs: $fp receiver record, $t4 attacker record, $t5 hit descriptor
calling_convention.return: Internal block continues at 0x8800a37c; native API returns only bounded memory status

reads: descriptor bytes 0x1d twice, 0x13 and 0x1a in original order
selected 8-byte lookup row bytes 0..2 at 0x88034610 + low_nibble*8
attacker and receiver position word 0x0c on the computed-height route
attacker byte 0x8e and optional variant byte at 0x88034647 + high_nibble
writes: receiver bytes 0xc4, 0xc5, 0xc6 and 0xc7 in order; earlier writes remain on later mapping failure

original.discovery_notes: The low-nibble row range and high-nibble variant map overlap in one guest address space. Unsigned subtraction wraps to 32 bits before the signed-negative clamp; final stores truncate to bytes. Aliasing can change the second descriptor 0x1d read.

verification.notes: Two fresh -nodrc controlled runs independently reached exact terminal PC 0x8800a37c for all 18 cases and produced identical scalar CSV SHA-256 091205165a3da3e001f2223083ca4d7e579e573bbe6abc115feab80a5c3d9e30. Executing effect/row/store/reread values agreed with ordered debugger before/after snapshots; every 16 KiB window and overlapping lookup table was bounded. This validates the declared control harness, not organic cache coherence, temporary registers, surrounding hit logic, scheduling, collision, damage, or gameplay.
